title: Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44), Lapse SR-26 Notice Schedule: Notice Days by the Backing Term's State
content:
On a lapse SR-26 under Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) (the SR-26 sent for a certificate whose backing term was cancelled and has since been reinstated with a lapse), lapse state notice days are added to the lapse run-off. They follow the state group of the backing term's own state:

- for a Named Non-Owner Policy term, the resident state on the term;
- for an Owner Auto Policy term, the garaging state on the term.

| Backing term's own state | Lapse state notice days added to the lapse run-off |
|---|---|
| Florida or Virginia | 4 days |
| Texas or Georgia | 2 days |
| Arizona or Ohio | no days |

**Basis Q&A**

- *Which state counts for an Operator certificate on a Named Non-Owner Policy term?* The resident state on that term, whatever the filing state.
- *Which state counts for an Owner certificate on an Owner Auto Policy term garaged in Georgia?* Georgia, so 2 days are added.
- *A Named Non-Owner Policy term with resident state Ohio:* no lapse state notice days are added.
